steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Promote low-carbon transport  
   • Expand and electrify public transit (e-buses, light rail)  
   • Build safe bike lanes and pedestrian zones  
   • Incentivize electric vehicles with charging infrastructure  

2. Boost building energy efficiency  
   • Retrofit existing buildings with better insulation, windows, and efficient HVAC  
   • Adopt stringent green-building codes for new construction  
   • Use smart meters and controls to optimize energy use  

3. Shift to clean energy  
   • Deploy rooftop and community solar, wind farms, and other renewables  
   • Modernize the grid with storage and demand-response systems  
   • Encourage on-site microgrids and district heating/cooling systems
